calibration: four expanding event blocks, completed training events only
history: verified calendar aligned PGA rounds; team/sealed events excluded from features and targets
course_feature: single official calendar course only; unknown/multi-course features omitted
market_probability: conditional decisive finish-order shadow probability only

integrity_repair.player_identity: tour:datagolf:dg_id; no alias-based history or target grouping
integrity_repair.aliases: source player_key/name values retained as provenance; ambiguous missing-ID projections withheld
integrity_repair.selection: same seven predetermined candidate specifications and original date splits; no test-based tuning
integrity_repair.reproducibility: exact merged training corpus retained before fitting, all SQLite source rows hashed, admission dependencies archived
integrity_repair.projection: tour and year resolved only by explicit year and/or unique bounded dated calendar match
